```artifact
Feature: Hospital Staff Requirements
  As a Hospital Staff
  I want to identify the information acquired from Patients, Chemists and Labs
  So that I can state the requirements of the software

  Scenario: Identify Information from Patients, Chemists and Labs
    Given the Hospital Staff has access to the system
    When they select the option to identify information from Patients, Chemists and Labs
    Then the system displays the information acquired from Patients, Chemists and Labs

  Scenario: State Requirements of the Software
    Given the Hospital Staff has access to the system
    When they select the option to state the requirements of the software
    Then the system displays the requirements of the software

  Scenario: Provide Feedback to Modify Existing Requirements
    Given the Hospital Staff has access to the system
    When they select the option to provide feedback to modify existing requirements
    Then the system allows them to modify the existing requirements

  Scenario: Reference Document for Project Management and Development Team
    Given the Hospital Staff has access to the system
    When they select the option to view the reference document
    Then the system displays the reference document for Project Management and Development team

  Scenario: Analyze, Design and Implement the System
    Given the Hospital Staff has access to the system
    When they select the option to analyze, design and implement the system
    Then the system allows them to analyze, design and implement the system

  Scenario Outline: Normal, Edge and Invalid Values
    Given the Hospital Staff has access to the system
    When they select the option to identify information from Patients, Chemists and Labs with the following values:
      | Patient ID | Chemist ID | Lab ID |
      | 1          | 1          | 1      |
      | 1          | 1          | 2      |
      | 1          | 2          | 1      |
      | 1          | 2          | 2      |
      | 2          | 1          | 1      |
      | 2          | 1          | 2      |
      | 2          | 2          | 1      |
      | 2          | 2          | 2      |
    Then the system displays the information acquired from Patients, Chemists and Labs

  Scenario Outline: Normal, Edge and Invalid Values
    Given the Hospital Staff has access to the system
    When they select the option to state the requirements of the software with the following values:
      | Requirement ID | Requirement Description |
      | 1              | This is a requirement    |
      | 1              | This is another requirement |
      | 2              | This is a requirement with a very long description that exceeds the maximum allowed length |
    Then the system displays the requirements of the software
```
